What the checks returned

Worst flag across the {{n_checks_word}} checks on the {{reference_split}} split: {{rollup_flag}}

Of the {{n_split_checks_word}} checks that measure a single split, {{n_checks_reported}} ran on {{reference_split}} and {{n_checks_scored}} were scored: {{n_checks_failed}} returned Fail, {{n_checks_warning}} returned Warning, {{n_checks_unknown}} returned Unknown. The leakage scan is counted in the flag above but not in these figures, because it compares pairs of splits rather than measuring one.

Every rollup figure on this page was measured on {{reference_split}}, which is this dataset's reference split — not a maximum over its splits.

The reports behind those flags

The full report genomic-benchmarks-qc rendered for each split and each split pair, with every distribution, every probe fit, and every individually-listed overlapping sequence behind the numbers on this page. Each opens inside this site, and the file the tool wrote is one click further on.

Worked examples of a report

The same features, read together

Every flag above is one feature on its own. This is all of them at once: length, GC, mononucleotide and dinucleotide content and the two per-position profiles, handed to a single model and scored on a held-out split. Nothing is added that the checks do not already look at — the only change is that they are read jointly.
